technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring XD's existing module architecture for porting Cassandra and PMML modules to s-c-s repo.
Implement HDFS HA support by leveraging Spring's NameNodeProxies.createHAProxy method instead of createNonHAProxy.
Design REST endpoints using Spring MVC to return job composition metadata (flag and graph).
Use JSON-based data structures for job composition graph representation in REST responses.
Implement job composition logic using Spring XD's existing job orchestration framework.
Assume UI integration for U7/U8 is out of scope; focus on backend data provision.
assumptions: Existing Cassandra and PMML modules in XD are compatible with s-c-s repo dependencies.
HDFS HA configuration details are available in the project's existing configuration.
Job composition data (parent-child relationships) is already tracked in the backend.
REST endpoints will be implemented as new controllers without modifying existing APIs.
All modules will be tested with Java 17+ as per Spring Framework 6.0 requirements.
No additional external systems beyond those mentioned in the specification are required.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement a module that allows connecting to multiple external systems for the same binding type, including configuration and testing.
Update HDFS module to use NameNodeProxies.createHAProxy for HA support and verify with Ambari integration.

activities.activity_name: Implement job composition flag REST endpoint (U5)
activities.activity_description: Create a REST endpoint that returns a flag indicating job composition type (parent-child vs standalone).

activities.activity_name: Implement job composition graph REST endpoint (U6)
activities.activity_description: Create a REST endpoint that returns a graph representation of job composition relationships.
Implement backend logic to differentiate between job-composition workflows and single jobs for UI use.
Implement backend support for navigating to job detail pages regardless of job composition status.
